title: Hayati Pro Max Lemon & Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Lemon & Lime delivers a sharp citrus blast with the tart edge of Lemon and the sweet zest of Lime in perfect balance. This classic flavour pairing brings a bright, fizzy quality that’s refreshing and punchy without being overpowering—ideal for vapers who enjoy clean, citrus-driven blends. Formulated with nicotine salts for faster nicotine satisfaction and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using low-powered pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG blend ensures consistent flavour and discreet vapour production. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
